items.summary: In the AdminProductForm component, replace the fixed Price input field with a Unit Type dropdown. The dropdown must have exactly four options: Kg, Gram, Packet, and Piece.

Update the backend Product type to include a unitType field (Kg, Gram, Packet, or Piece) instead of or in addition to the price field. Modify the addProduct function to accept and store the unit type.

On the shop page (ProductCard and CartDrawer), for products with unit type 'Kg' or 'Gram', display a text input field where customers can enter custom weight values. Accept inputs like '100g', '0.5kg', '1.5kg', '250g' and parse them correctly.

On the shop page (ProductCard and CartDrawer), for products with unit type 'Packet' or 'Piece', display only '+' and '-' quantity buttons for incrementing/decrementing whole number quantities. Hide the custom weight input for these unit types.

Update the cart data structure to support both quantity-based items (Packet, Piece) and weight-based items (Kg, Gram). Modify the backend addToCart and related cart functions to handle both types correctly.

Update all product display components (ProductCard, AdminProductList, BillTemplate) to show the unit type instead of or alongside the price. Ensure billing and checkout flows correctly calculate totals based on unit type and quantity/weight.
